en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a quiet semi‑rural road curving through a small town. On the right are simple wooden houses with pitched roofs and fenced gardens; a few bicycles are visible by the roadside. A small 1930s–1950s style car drives away from the camera along the paved road, which has streetlamps and telegraph poles. On the left is an open grassy area leading to water or wetland, with a bench and low fencing. In the distance, beyond trees and low buildings, rises a church with a tall, narrow spire. The sky is wide and lightly clouded. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
